app-monolith.summary: Client, TS service, and relational DB, shipped together.
app-monolith.adds: Migrations own schema; adds architecture/ and database/.
app-monolith.rule: Keep repo skills repo-only; never install them user-level.

content-library.summary: Prompts, playbooks, and templates curated as the product.

design-vault.summary: Design and worldbuilding vault; its documents are the product.
design-vault.rule: Edit in Obsidian, version in git, keep it agent-readable.

gas-webapp.summary: Apps Script web app with Code.gs and HTML templates.
gas-webapp.adds: Push and deploy with clasp; root appsscript.json; V8.
gas-webapp.rule: /exec is production, not /dev; archive stale deployments.

local-tool.summary: Local CLI or scripts: no server, browser, or deployment.
local-tool.adds: No extra step; pass npm test and run the command.
local-tool.rule: ESM .mjs only; no build tools and no dependencies.

office-automation.summary: Excel software in .xlsm: payroll, dashboards, or reporting.
office-automation.adds: Export VBA; the .xlsm artifact itself contains the code.
office-automation.rule: Git sees code only after export; skip it and lose the diff.

userscript.summary: Browser script injected by a userscript manager.
userscript.adds: Release the tagged .user.js itself; no build and no host.
userscript.rule: One root .user.js with metadata; never read it whole.

web-app.summary: Public site or marketing app, static-first on an edge host.
web-app.adds: A static-first framework, a src/ tree, and a build step.
web-app.rule: Host owns env config; verify the live URL after deploy.

callouts: No code before a failing test.
No non-trivial implementation before an approved plan review.
/ship does NOT create the git tag or the GitHub Release.
/handoff ends a phase; /continuum prepares a new chat.

scenarios.path: issue/PR plan -> worktree -> failing test -> implement -> /review ->
issue -> plan + ADR -> /plan-eng-review -> TDD -> security audit -> /review ->
/ship -> human merge -> annotated tag -> GitHub Release -> deploy ->
/orient -> handoff log -> continue named phase -> phase closer ->
/new-project -> read generated CLAUDE.md -> setup repo -> first issue ->

overlaps.exception: No second debugging skill in the same pass
Never both in one review pass
/continuum only when a new chat must start
/qa proves behavior in the running surface
/deliberate only when options are genuinely contested

sections.title: Close the branch
sections.lead: Choose one closer after the work is complete.
items: /ship for a versioned product OR finishing-a-development-branch for a quick task
sections.stop: STOP FOR HUMAN MERGE. Agent cannot merge.

sections.title: Deploy and verify
sections.lead: Use only the active profile's deploy command.
items: Name rollback or stop point before deploy
Verify the live URL, deployment ID, or opened workbook
sections.stop: Command success is NOT production verification.

sections.title: Publish a public export
sections.lead: Regenerate public from private source; never edit the export directly.
items: Dry-run, then actually READ the entire file list
Build a fresh export; scan it independently with gitleaks
Remove stale public files deliberately - export never deletes

release.stopBand: No tag without a GitHub Release - no deploy without production verification - no public export without dry-run + independent secret scan
release.footnote: Checklist only - use the active profile's workflow for execution details.

destinations.docsRule: DOCS RULE: docs/ is flat except designs/, adr/, records/ and whatever the active profile's docs-subdirs adds.
destinations.stopRule: No TODO files, no docs/bugs, no loose investigation notes, no second task tracker.
destinations.footnote: One artifact, one canonical home. Link it; do not copy it.
